Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Use Azure CLI to create and manage lab VMs

Body.Content:
The latest version of Azure CLI 2.0 includes commands for Azure DevTest Labs users to create and manage lab VMs. You can easily achieve the following tasks through command-line experience by using your favorite operating systems (including Windows, Linux, and MacOS):

  • Create a VM from an Azure Marketplace image, custom image, or formula
  • List VMs and relevant resources such as images, artifacts, and formulas
  • Start/stop a VM
  • Connect to a VM
  • Apply artifacts to a VM

For more details, check out the DevTest Labs CLI command reference. If you are new to Azure CLI, follow these instructions to install Azure CLI 2.0.
